dang-nhap.title: Sign in | Chuyện Nhỏ
dang-nhap.description: Sign in to Chuyện Nhỏ with your email and password. Create an account or reset your password with a code sent by email.

tai-khoan.title: Account | Chuyện Nhỏ
tai-khoan.description: Your Chuyện Nhỏ account, current plan and public profile.

de-xuat-cua-toi.title: My proposals | Chuyện Nhỏ
de-xuat-cua-toi.description: Track the proposals and feedback you sent with your Chuyện Nhỏ account, and add sources when needed.

login.title: Sign in to <accent>Chuyện Nhỏ</accent>
login.intro: Sign in with your email and password. No account yet? Create one with your email in about a minute.
login.terms: By signing in or creating an account you agree to the <terms>Terms of use</terms> and the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
login.asideNote: Every tool still works without signing in. Your files are still processed only in your browser.

attributed.title: Proposals under your name
attributed.text: Suggest rule fixes or tool ideas under your name instead of anonymously.

track.title: Track your proposals
track.text: See where each proposal stands without keeping receipt codes.

pro.title: Ready for Pro
pro.text: An AI assistant that runs on your own AI key, with cloud storage and sync across devices.

setup.codeSentTo: We sent a code to {{email}}. It is valid for 10 minutes.
setup.codeHint: No email? Check your Spam or Promotions folder.
setup.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. A memorable phrase, like “white clouds over the hill”, is both long and hard to guess.
setup.resent: A new code is on its way. The previous one no longer works.

signup.title: Create a <accent>Chuyện Nhỏ</accent> account
signup.intro: Enter your email and we will send a 6-digit code to confirm the mailbox is yours. Then choose a password for signing in later.

reset.title: Reset your <accent>password</accent>
reset.intro: Enter your account email and we will send a 6-digit code. Once the new password is set, every signed-in device is signed out.

plan.title: Current plan
plan.endingSoon: Your Pro plan ends soon. Renew to keep the AI assistant and keep saving results.
plan.freeText: Use every tool and send proposals under your name. Upgrade to Pro for your own AI assistant.

capability.agent: AI assistant on your own AI key
capability.cloud: Save tool data to the cloud
capability.history: History of your AI assistant sessions

pro.title: Pro
pro.text: Your own AI assistant running on your key (OpenAI, Gemini, Anthropic…), cloud storage, sync and history.

profile.title: Public profile
profile.text: Used only when a proposal of yours is approved and published.
profile.displayNameHelp: Up to 80 characters. Leave empty to stay unnamed.
profile.publicAttribution: Show my name on published proposals

email.title: Sign-in email
email.current: You sign in with {{email}}. Codes and account notices go to this address.
email.needsPassword: Set a password under Password first, then you can change your email.
email.formHint: We send a 6-digit code to the new address to make sure the mailbox is yours. Once changed, the old address gets a notice and other devices are signed out.
email.changed: Sign-in email changed. Other devices have been signed out.

security.title: Password
security.text: Changing the password signs out every other device; this one stays signed in.
security.noPassword: This account was created before passwords existed. Set one with a code sent to {{email}} so you can sign in next time without waiting for an email.
security.changed: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
security.set: Password set. Next time, sign in with your email and this password.
security.sessionsText: Forgot to sign out somewhere, or noticed something odd? End every session except this device.
security.sessionsButton: Sign out of all other devices
security.sessionsEnded: Other devices have been signed out.
security.sessionsNone: No other device is signed in.

signOut.title: Sign out
signOut.text: End the session on this device.

delete.title: Delete account
delete.text: Permanently delete this account. This cannot be undone.

points.data: Your email, password, sessions, Pro plan, saved items and source-check history are deleted.
points.ai: Your AI assistant and AI key are removed from the assistant server.
points.contributions: Suggestions you sent are kept but no longer linked to you.

delete.staff: Staff accounts cannot delete themselves. Ask an owner to remove the role first.
delete.needsPassword: Set a password in the Password section first; deleting the account is confirmed with it.
delete.done: Your account has been deleted. Thank you for using Chuyện Nhỏ.

mine.title: My proposals
mine.text: See the status of proposals sent with this account and add sources when a reviewer needs them.

errors.EMAIL_INVALID: That email address does not look right.
errors.OTP_INVALID: The code is wrong or has expired.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.ACCOUNT_DISABLED: This account has been locked. Contact contact@lpc.vn.
errors.SIGNUP_CLOSED: New sign-ups are closed for now. Existing accounts can still sign in.
errors.UNTRUSTED_REQUEST: The request was rejected. Reload the page and try again.
errors.SIGNED_OUT: Your session has ended. Please sign in again.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: The password needs at least 8 characters.
errors.PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: The password can be at most 128 characters.
errors.PASSWORD_COMMON: That password is too easy to guess (or matches your email). Please choose another.
errors.PASSWORD_NOT_SET: This account has no password yet. Set one in the Password section first.
errors.NETWORK: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.UNKNOWN: Something went wrong. Please try again later.
errors.EVIDENCE_CLOSED: This proposal has been reviewed; sources can no longer be added.
errors.TOO_MANY_SOURCES: A proposal can have at most 10 sources.
errors.SOURCE_INVALID: Invalid source. Use a public HTTPS link without keys or access codes.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This proposal was not found. Reload the page.
errors.STAFF_ACCOUNT: Staff accounts cannot delete themselves. Ask an owner to remove the role first.
errors.DELETE_FAILED: Your account could not be deleted right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
errors.EMAIL_TAKEN: Another account already uses this email.

box.signedInAs: Sending as {{email}}, so you can follow this proposal without a receipt code.
box.attribution: Credit me by name when it is published
box.profileHint: Your name only shows if your profile has a display name and credit turned on. Change it on the <account>account page</account>.

mine.title: My <accent>proposals</accent>
mine.intro: Proposals and feedback you sent while signed in. Ones sent while signed out are not listed here; look them up with their receipt code.

empty.title: You have not sent any proposals yet
empty.text: Suggest a tool or send feedback on regulation data; it will show up here with its review status.

mine.needsSourceHint: The reviewer needs an official source before looking at this proposal.

evidence.help: HTTPS links only. Up to 10 sources per proposal.
evidence.httpsOnly: The link must start with https://
evidence.added: Source added. The proposal is waiting for review.
